issue.title: Upgrade to Expo SDK 57 (React Native 0.86)
issue.body:
## Summary

Upgrade Fluent Mobile from **Expo SDK 56 / React Native 0.85** to **Expo SDK 57 / React Native 0.86**.

SDK 57 is a focused Expo release that brings RN 0.86 into the Expo ecosystem. React stays on **19.2**. Expo positions this as a straightforward, intentionally non-breaking upgrade — but it still needs a dedicated ticket (Dependabot PR #199 was closed for this reason).

This app is **Android-only CNG**. No iOS work.

## Current vs expected

| | Current | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Expo | `~56.0.18` | `~57.x` |
| React Native | `0.85.3` | `0.86.x` |
| React | `19.2.3` | `19.2.x` (unchanged line) |

## Scope

### In scope

- Bump `expo@^57.0.0` and align all Expo / RN packages via `npx expo install --fix`
- Regenerate Android native project (`npm run prebuild` — `--platform android` only)
- Validate custom config plugins, native modules, and jest mocks
- Update docs / Dependabot pins from SDK 56 / RN 0.85 → SDK 57 / RN 0.86
- Fresh EAS Android development or preview build
- Android device QA (required before ready-for-review)

### Out of scope (separate tickets)

- Expo Router migration
- Migrating off `expo-file-system/legacy`
- Jest 30 / ESLint 10 / Prettier 3 / TypeScript 7 tooling majors
- React Navigation feature bumps beyond what `expo install --fix` pulls
- Anything iOS

## File pointers & approach

1. **Deps:** [`package.json`](package.json) — `npx expo install expo@^57.0.0 --fix` then `npx expo-doctor@latest`
2. **App config / plugins:** [`app.config.ts`](app.config.ts), [`plugins/withRNScreensFragmentFactory.js`](plugins/withRNScreensFragmentFactory.js), [`plugins/withAppWindowBackground.js`](plugins/withAppWindowBackground.js)
3. **High-risk natives:** `@op-engineering/op-sqlite`, `react-native-bootsplash`, `expo-audio`, `expo-file-system/legacy`
4. **Jest:** [`jest.config.cjs`](jest.config.cjs), [`jest.setup.expo-fs.cjs`](jest.setup.expo-fs.cjs), [`src/test/mocks/expo-audio.ts`](src/test/mocks/expo-audio.ts)
5. **Dependabot:** [`.github/dependabot.yml`](.github/dependabot.yml) — raise RN ignore floor from `>=0.86.0` → `>=0.87.0`
6. **Docs/rules mentioning SDK 56:** `README.md`, `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`, `docs/guides/expo-first-dependencies.md`, `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md`, `.cursor/rules/project-overview.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/expo-mcp.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/dependabot-workflow.mdc`

### Suggested commands

```bash
npx expo install expo@^57.0.0 --fix
npx expo-doctor@latest
npm run prebuild   # android only; already --clean
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] App builds and runs on Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86 (Android)
- [ ] `npx expo-doctor` and `npx expo install --check` pass
- [ ] CI gates pass (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci`)
- [ ] Custom prebuild plugins still apply correctly after clean Android prebuild
- [ ] Android device QA checklist completed and noted on the PR
- [ ] Docs / Dependabot pins updated to SDK 57 / RN 0.86
- [ ] Fresh EAS Android dev-client or preview build produced post-upgrade

## Verification / device QA

**CI:** format → lint → typecheck → test → doctor / install-check

**Android device (minimum):**

1. Cold start: BootSplash → login / session restore
2. Post-login sync (SQLite) and Sync screen
3. Record take → save → playback → upload when online
4. Mic permission deny / grant
5. Secure store: logout / session restore
6. Connectivity gating (offline / cellular) for sync/upload
7. Stack navigation + gesture-handler (no fragment crash on chapter/drafting)

Native modules change → keep PR draft / not ready-for-review until human device results are on the PR.

## Links

- [Expo SDK 57 changelog](https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-57)
- [Upgrade Expo SDK walkthrough](https://docs.expo.dev/workflow/upgrading-expo-sdk-walkthrough/)
- [React Native 0.86 release notes](https://reactnative.dev/blog/2026/06/11/react-native-0.86)
- Prior Dependabot close: PR #199 (see `docs/guides/dependabot-resolution-log.md`)
